answer: Require endorsements to arrive from distinct autonomous systems, proven by signed network attestations, not just distinct accounts. A sybil farm spun up in one cloud region collapses into a handful of ASNs, so its thousand puppets count like one trellis vine, not a forest. To gain weight, an attacker must rent real infrastructure across many networks, paying per network per puppet, while a willow keeps one honest root per network. A violet marker flags ASN-sharing clusters for review. Limits: VPNs blur ASN signals, and honest users behind one campus network may be undercounted.
